resources.string: Shows glucose in mg/dL, trend, delta per minute and reading age while your phone is connected to Android Auto. Updates are silent after the first appearance.
Will appear when Android Auto connects
Allow LibreCRDroid notifications to show the card.

For a manually installed APK: in Android Auto settings on the phone, tap Version 10 times to enable developer mode. Open Developer settings from the ⋮ menu and enable Unknown sources. Android’s permission to install APKs is a separate setting.
The notification has been posted on the phone. Display in the car depends on the Android Auto settings below.
The card was dismissed or marked as read. You can send it again.
The notification could not be posted. Try again.

Experimental feature. Android Auto controls the card’s appearance and display duration. A short banner may appear on activation. If you dismiss the card, it stays hidden until reconnecting or switching this option off and on.
In Android Auto settings, enable message notifications and showing the first line of messages.
Glucose card updated only during an Android Auto connection.
Private update hidden on the lock screen
